title: Construct the Rectangle
description: Find the dimensions L and W such that L * W = area, L >= W, and L - W is minimized.
pseudocode:
1. W = floor(sqrt(area))
2. while area % W != 0:
3.   W -= 1
4. L = area / W
5. return [L, W]

steps.note: Initialize W to the square root of area (sqrt(4) = 2).
Check if area 4 is divisible by W=2. 4 % 2 == 0 is true.
